{"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :-
1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC.
2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm.
3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT.
4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N3 instructs to keep threads soft and to retap after surface treatment, but no thread feature or thread dimension is shown anywhere on the drawing. This will confuse the machinist who cannot locate the threads to protect or rework; the designer should either add the missing thread dimensions or remove the thread-related instructions from the note."
    ,
    "recommended_correction":"Add the thread callouts and dimensions to the drawing, or delete items 3 and 4 of note N3 if no threads exist on this part."}]}
